description: VIUS Data for VIUS tabulation Tool is a dataset listed in data.bts.gov (Bureau of Transportation Statistics open data), an open data portal of the Bureau of Transportation Statistics under the section "Trucking and Motorcoaches", published or maintained by USDOT/Bureau of Transportation Statistics. A translation of the 2021 VIUS PUF file for use in the VIUS data tabulation tool. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Trucking and Motorcoaches". It has 168 columns, among them LE_WEIGHTHI, LF_BEYOND, LOADEDPCT, RO_51_100, RO_GT500, ST_ROLLOVER. The portal shows 2024-05-02 as the last data update. Attribution given: USDOT/Bureau of Transportation Statistics. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-bts-data-bts-gov-portal.
